## :dart: About ## Spacescape is a 2D top-down space shooter written in dart using Flutter and the awesome Flame engine. ## :sparkles: Features ## :heavy_check_mark: It works! 😅 ## :rocket: Technologies ## The following tools were used in this project: - [Dart](https://dart.dev/) - [Flutter](https://flutter.dev/) - [Flame Engine](https://flame-engine.org/) ## :white_check_mark: Requirements ## Before starting :checkered_flag:, you need to have [Git](https://git-scm.com) and [Flutter](https://flutter.dev/) installed. ## :checkered_flag: Starting ## ```bash # Clone this project $ git clone https://github.com/ufrshubham/spacescape # Access $ cd spacescape # Install dependencies $ flutter pub get # Run the project $ flutter run # The server will run the game on any connect and supported device. ``` ## :memo: License ## This project is under license from MIT.
